_comment: Optional overrides for gemini_workflow/lora_dataset_builder.py. Every key under 'profiles' is a --profile name; values are merged over the built-in DEFAULT_PROFILES. Copy the '_example' block to add a new character. Fields: game (caption token + folder group), character (danbooru-style tag), trigger (dataset/trigger word), repeat (kohya repeat prefix), dataset_group (folder under data/train_data), gender/identity/outfit (caption tag lists), identity_prompt/outfit_prompt (generation wording), must_keep (identity rules the prompt must state), avoid (extra negative wording), require_ahoge (reject shots where the ahoge is missing).

lohen.identity_prompt: short messy sage-green hair with soft spiky layered tufts and a long side-swept fringe over the forehead, DULL CRIMSON-RED eyes, one solid colour in BOTH eyes (never pink, magenta or purple; never a two-tone iris, never a green, cyan or white pupil or inner iris), a small beauty mark under his right eye (the viewer's left in a front view), a young-boy anime face with light skin
lohen.outfit_prompt: a white high-collared shirt with a silver and pale-blue winged emblem on the chest, a pale-blue corset-like vest with small diamond details and a dark diagonal chest strap, a long dark-navy coat with gold trim and silver arrow-shaped clasps, a short dark-navy half-cape with a light-blue lining and silver-and-gold shoulder pauldrons, black gloves with blue fingertips and a dark-navy bracer with gold trim, white trousers with a dark-navy thigh strap and a silver cross emblem, and tall dark-navy boots with silver armored toe caps
must_keep: the short dark-navy half-cape stays over the shoulders and never hides the chest emblem
the outfit keeps its white trousers and tall dark boots - never a skirt, shorts or bare legs
the eyes are one solid DULL CRIMSON RED in BOTH eyes - never pink, magenta or purple, never two different colours, and never a two-tone iris with a green, cyan or white pupil
lohen.eye_line: BOTH eyes are clearly visible and are one solid dull crimson red - never pink, magenta or purple, never a two-tone iris with a green or cyan pupil.

traits.expect: BOTH irises one solid dull crimson-red colour. 'wrong' if either iris is pink, magenta, purple or vivid scarlet, if the two eyes differ, or if the iris/pupil is two-tone (a green, cyan or white pupil or inner iris). 'partial' if the red base is right but a subtle greenish rim on the outer iris edge is missing - the rim is a bonus, never a requirement. 'unclear' if the eyes are too small or hidden to tell.
a small beauty mark (mole) under his right eye, which appears on the viewer's LEFT in a front view

_example.identity_prompt: long blonde hair in two pigtails with small pointed elf ears, red eyes, a child-like anime face
_example.outfit_prompt: a red hooded coat with a white collar, a broad red hat with a four-leaf clover ornament, white gloves and brown boots
must_keep: the big red hat stays on the head in every shot
